title: Real form of parity multiplication
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a set of coordinates among $n$ coordinates, and let $g$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The real-valued function associated with the pointwise product of $g$ and the parity on $S$ is the pointwise product of the monomial on $S$ and the real-valued function associated with $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates among $n$ coordinates
$g$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
